findings.passage: Most of the voter fraud, I find, that goes on is elderly people being taken advantage of,
findings.note: Direct quote in Jackson Free Press, said while explaining why he backed a photo ID initiative: he describes the fraud he sees as mostly affecting elderly voters.

findings.passage: Someone will try to vote for John Doe because they know he's at home sick or can't get out of the nursing home.
findings.note: Direct quote in Jackson Free Press giving an example of the voter fraud he wants photo ID to address.

findings.passage: You had charges of voting by dead people, voting by people that were out of the county,
findings.note: Direct quote in Jackson Free Press about the fraud charges he cites in the Jefferson Davis County circuit clerk primary, as his example for photo ID.

findings.motion: Sponsor of the photo voter ID constitutional initiative (Initiative Measure Number 27, ms4voterid.com petition drive)
findings.note: Magnolia Tribune reports he sponsors the photo voter ID initiative petition and launched its website and a Facebook group; a 2011-01-10 Magnolia Tribune piece says petition organizers were led by him. Initiative later went to the 2011 ballot.
